statement: Linux's inactive MP probe requests six bytes at A600FA and accepts exactly six bytes with last byte 0x05; it does not compare builtin A4200005 vs external A6200005. Probe failure prevents creation of MP evdev; builtin MP suppresses four-second polling but not the initial hotplug reconciliation probe or later scheduled status/hotplug work. Base input can persist.
